facts.text: John faced self-doubt during his journey, questioning if he was on the right track.

evidence.quote: There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track.
I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.

facts.text: John received support from loved ones, which helped him overcome challenges.

evidence.quote: With support at home and my own grit, I powered through.
Plus it helps a lot when you've got loved ones supporting you.
Support from loved ones is vital. I'm really lucky to have my family on this journey with me.

facts.text: John's promotion is a reward for his efforts and a symbol of overcoming obstacles.

evidence.quote: This promotion is a reward for all the hustle and hardship I put in - a reminder that I'm on the right path.
It's a symbol of all the obstacles I had to overcome to get here.
